mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM inbound_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM outbound_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(current_stock), 0) FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stock_type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inboundQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN stock_type = 'OUT' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outboundQuantity FROM stock_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'UNHANDLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unhandled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'UNHANDLED' AND alert_type = 'BELOW_MIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS belowMin, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'UNHANDLED' AND alert_type = 'ABOVE_MAX' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS aboveMax FROM stock_alert WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT product_name AS productName, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS outboundQuantity FROM stock_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND stock_type = 'OUT' GROUP BY product_id, product_name ORDER BY outboundQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, COALESCE(SUM(i.actual_quantity), 0) AS stockQuantity FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inbound_order o ON o.warehouse_id = w.id AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN inbound_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.is_deleted = 0 WHERE w.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY w.id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY stockQuantity DESC
